key_points.text: Yahoo is comprised of legacy Yahoo and AOL businesses, which peaked at a combined market cap of $350 billion in the dot.com heyday.
It still hosts 900 million monthly active users and is the 3rd largest internet property.
So what did Apollo see as the potential in this longstanding, slowly declining business?

 Yahoo on Private Equity Deals Apr 19, 2023

 Listen to Yahoo
on Private Equity Deals . 

 The fifth episode of Season 2 of Private Equity Deals
releases today. We discuss Apollo’s purchase of Yahoo a year and a
half ago. You heard that right – Apollo bought Yahoo.

Yahoo is comprised of legacy Yahoo and AOL businesses, which peaked
at a combined market cap of $350 billion in the dot.com heyday. It
still hosts 900 million monthly active users and is the 3rd largest
internet property.

 

So what did Apollo see as the potential in this longstanding,
slowly declining business?  Search for Private Equity Deals on
your podcast player to find out.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
